question: Why can no being other than the Lord possess true agency?
premises: True agency consists only in knowledge, will, and effort.
No other factor constitutes agency beyond knowledge, will, and effort.
Therefore agency cannot belong to any other being at any time.
inference: Since agency is nothing but knowledge, will, and effort, no one other than the supreme agent can ever be a true doer.
plain_english: Agency is nothing other than knowledge, will, and effort; therefore no one else can ever possess true agency.
